bio.text: Tim Moore represents North Carolina's 14th Congressional District and serves on the House Committees on Financial Services and the Budget.
He previously served for a decade as Speaker of the North Carolina House of Representatives.

A lifelong resident of Kings Mountain, he earned a B.A. in political science from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1992 and a law degree from Oklahoma City University School of Law in 1995.
He has practiced law in Cleveland County throughout his career.
